message: ライバルとリサイクル

name: Misa
message: 「Victory belongs to the Crusaders!!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're really getting into it, Misa-chan」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course I am. Evildoing cannot be forgiven, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it's not like they were doing anything that bad today……」

name: Misa
message: 「What's your deal, Sakura-kun? Taking the demons' side like that」

name: Synn
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aha~ Don't tell me――」

name: Synn
message: 「*Flinch*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You fell for Sally-chan at first sight or something」

name: Synn
message: 「No, definitely not. End of story」

name: Sally
message: 「Kieee! All of you just running your mouths! Feel the full-throttle power of Sally-chan's grudge!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugya! The handcart is right there――」

name: Synn
message: 「Watch out, get down!」
Shielding the people closest to me, I dropped flat to the ground.

name: Sally
message: 「Awawawawa! Run for it, everyone」

name: Ria
message: 「Is everyone okay!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Cough*, *cough*……」
For now, it looks like Lolotte and Nanaka are unharmed.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about the handcart!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh…… ughh……」
Misa is using her own body to shield the handcart. What Sally-chan threw wasn't an explosive, just a smoke bomb.

name: Misa
message: 「Looks like it made it through somehow……」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, are you all right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Something like this is no big dea――」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa!」
As she staggers unsteadily, I hurriedly catch her in my arms.

name: Ria
message: 「It looks like you inhaled quite a bit of smoke.」

name: Misa
message: 「T-This much is nothing...!」

name: Ria
message: 「No! You have to rest.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahh, Onee-sama... how kind you are\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, it'd be great if there were somewhere she could lie down, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun... I can walk on my own, so...\s03 Um... could you let go of me?」
When I look at Senpai, she shakes her head silently.

name: Nanaka
message: 「With that much energy, she'll be better in no time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I found a place where she can lie down!」
What Lolotte turned her eyes toward was the rear cart that Misa had put her body on the line to protect.

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why am I being put through this...」
Inside the rear cart, Misa is grumbling to herself.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It looks fun~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's carrying the person who saved its life, so the rear cart must be thrilled.」

name: Ria
message: 「Or would you rather have Synn-kun give you a piggyback ride?」

name: Misa
message: 「Here is just fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha...\s02」

name: Misa
message: 「It's not a laughing matter! Be a little more considerate and do something about this rear cart... honestly.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President had his hands full just protecting us, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I was just completely caught up in the moment...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Trying to look all cool--what a smooth guy!」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan. Please don't do anything reckless like that anymore, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes. I'm sorry...」

name: Ria
message: 「Mhmm♪ Good, as long as you get it!」
And so, we ended up calling it a day right there.

name: Paqy
message: 「Curry again today, huh...」
Hmm. So our only loot is cardboard boxes and a cuckoo clock~~.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, I've made up my mind!」
After putting the dishes in the sink, I change back into my school uniform.

name: Paqy
message: 「Where ya headed, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「To the shopping district」

name: Paqy
message: 「Scavenging for unwanted stuff?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yep, yep. I felt bad leaving it all to Misa, so I figured I'd gather a little more」

name: Paqy
message: 「Walking alone at night is dangerous, ya know」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why don't you come along with me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I dug my own grave...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, ain't Soba coming?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka ran out of nori, so she's out buying some. Well, I've got you with me, Paqy, so it's fine」

name: Paqy
message: 「I wanna go home...」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, where should we start making our rounds?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's go raid Soba's place」

name: Synn
message: 「Soba is best when it's freshly made, you know. Her dad seemed really bummed that he couldn't help out with the bazaar」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then let's go get some freshly made soba from him」

name: Synn
message: 「The only way to pull that off is to have him come to the academy...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, good evening. Out shopping?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh... N-No. Th-That's...」

name: Synn
message: 「Feeling better already?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't worry about me. Something like that isn't enough to weaken me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. That's good.」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you here for, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking about gathering a few more unwanted items.」

name: Synn
message: 「So you're not out shopping, huh. If you've got time, maybe together--」

name: Misa
message: 「He beat me to it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. Who can gather more unwanted items... It's a contest!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Just you watch! I'm going to redeem myself from earlier!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, that's totally inefficient.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just the type who can't say no when challenged...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Try losing on purpose for once.」

name: Synn
message: 「Throw the match? What would I do if she found out!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't even wanna imagine.」
And so, when challenged to a contest, I have no choice but to take it on. If I'm doing this, I'm going to win!

name: Synn
message: 「Good evening~. I'm Synn Sakura from Ryuusei Academy~」
And then, time's up!

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph.」
Misa crosses her arms, looking brimming with confidence.

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, tell me how much you collected first, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, got it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee. In times like these, the one who goes second always wins.」

name: Synn
message: 「I got four.」

name: Misa
message: 「Grr!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's getting late, so I think that's my limit.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph... Not bad at all... Well, I suppose we both put up a good fight.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, let's call it a 'draw' for today--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, you're forgetting this dishwasher.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Sorry, sorry. I left it with you, Paqy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh. Guess that makes five.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shiiiin!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't be such a stranger, honestly! Tell us where you're going next time!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Ria
message: 「Getting a head start on us isn't fair!」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone...!」
It seems the three of them pitched in and gathered unwanted items too. They load the things into a handcart.

name: Ria
message: 「We actually collected quite a lot.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This much is a piece of cake!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even we can get things done when it counts, you know.」
If only it 'counted' all the time.

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, what did you gather, Misa?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You have quite a lot too, Vice President~」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes!」
Misa tosses the things she gathered into the handcart with a couple of plops.

name: Misa
message: 「The outcome of the match is shrouded in darkness, you know」

name: Paqy
message: 「Four of 'em」

name: Misa
message: 「We only won because you were there, Paqy! Don't you forget that!」
On the way home too, everyone browsed through all sorts of shops together, and treasures kept piling higher and higher onto the handcart.
